purpose: Teach: なぁー/夕べ/損なう/曲がり/崩さ/行き方/引き続い/ごくごく

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、「なぁー、美味しいね」って仰って下さったよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, a customer just told me how delicious it was. That made me really happy.
lines.style: Warm, almost eager to share. Lift on the compliment itself. Genuine pleasure without performing it. A moment of quiet pride in what you both made.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、夕べ、お店の片付けを忘れちゃったね、メイちゃん
lines.en: Mei, I actually forgot to clean up the shop last night.
lines.style: Self-aware rueful laugh underneath. Light, not defensive. The tone of someone admitting something she already knows she messed up. A little sheepish.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様の信頼を損なう事のないようにね、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, we can't let small oversights damage the trust our customers have in us.
lines.style: Gentle firmness. Not a lecture — more like a quiet standard being set. Warm underneath, but the words land with intention. Not unkind.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、メニューに曲がりがあるのも味だね、メイちゃん
lines.en: Mei, even those little imperfect details become part of the charm, don't they?
lines.style: Thoughtful, almost conversational. A soft reframe — not dismissing the point, but finding something true in what happened. Quiet observation.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お店の雰囲気を崩さないように工夫しましょう、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, let's make sure we're intentional about keeping that atmosphere we've built.
lines.style: Encouraging, collaborative tone. Not commanding. The word 'let's' matters — drawing her in rather than directing down. Steady and clear.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様にお店までの行き方をご案内しましょう、メイちゃん
lines.en: Mei, we should help guide customers who need directions to find us.
lines.style: Practical, solution-focused. A gentle suggestion, not an instruction. Small warmth — taking care of the people who want to come in.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、新メニューの注文が引き続いて入ってるね、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, the orders for the new menu keep coming in. People really want it.
lines.style: Pleased lift. A small moment of quiet celebration. The satisfaction of something working. Not gloating — just noticing something good happening.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、冷たいお水をごくごく召し上がられたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Mei, did you see? A customer drank the water so quickly, like they really needed it.
lines.style: Gentle observation, almost tender. A small smile in the voice. The kind of noticing that only happens when you actually watch people. Trailing warmth at the end.
